note: Private campground on a wooded point of Old Taylor Lake, about 2 miles from the Waupaca Chain O' Lakes. Water/electric sites on natural ground or concrete pads (some with decks looking over the lake), full-hookup pad sites, cabins and a yurt; solar-heated pool, game room and playground. About 40 of its 100-odd RV sites are seasonal. --Claude
summary: Operator pages read live via the headless browser (the plain-HTTP 406 does not apply to a browser): 2026 rates $42-65 for 2 adults + 4 children, season May 1-Oct 1, 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimums, full payment at booking. 2024 site map counted: 61 nightly RV + 4 tent + 42 seasonal sites (about 61% nightly). Passes the price gate at $42-49 W/E. Lakeview kept (shore rows under canopy). Note corrected: the park is on Old Taylor Lake, not the Chain O' Lakes.
